source: Antigravity CLI (owner 05/11/2026: «sao lại xài cái hình từ đời nào»), brief docs/codex-briefs/hagrid-chibi-s7.md, prompt names Rubeus Hagrid
poses: idle, blink, raise, wave (cells 1–4 of the 3 × 2 sheet; prep-friend-master + 2 × 2 atlas)
prompt:
A 3x2 character sprite sheet of Rubeus Hagrid from the Harry Potter books (not the films, not looking like any actor), rendered in chunky 16-bit pixel art style matching the approved Harry sprite sheet and Dobby sprite sheet: dark #231F2E outlines, light from the top-left, flat color shading, pure solid white background.

Character design of Rubeus Hagrid (book version):
A lovable half-giant chibi gamekeeper of Hogwarts, about 1.5x the height of Harry and much broader with huge shoulders, big hands, and boots, retaining cute chibi proportions with a large head. Wild tangled long black hair and a bushy black beard hiding most of his lower face, small kind beetle-black eyes crinkling with warmth, rosy cheeks. Wearing an oversized brown moleskin coat with bulging patch pockets, a dark waistcoat underneath, a wide leather belt with a brass buckle, and dark trousers tucked into enormous brown boots. A folded pink flowered umbrella is strapped across his back and visible poking out over his screen-right shoulder. A freestanding brass lantern stands on the ground right next to his screen-right boot in EVERY pose (never held in hands).

Sheet format:
3x2 grid (3 columns by 2 rows) on a clean, solid white background with generous empty spacing between poses, no background, no shadows, no floor tiles, no grid lines, no text. All 6 poses face three-quarter view toward the lower-left, sharing the exact same scale, sprite height, and row baselines:
Row 1:
1. 'idle' (top-left): Rubeus Hagrid standing still, warm smile, both hands resting relaxed at his sides. Brass lantern sitting on the ground next to his screen-right boot.
2. 'blink' (top-middle): Exactly the same stance, body, coat, hands, umbrella, and ground lantern as idle, but eyes closed in a gentle blink.
3. 'raise' (top-right): Same standing stance, his screen-left hand (viewer's left side) lifted to shoulder height with open palm facing forward to begin waving; screen-right hand rests at his side. Lantern on the ground at screen-right boot.

Row 2:
4. 'wave' (bottom-left): Same standing stance, his screen-left hand (viewer's left side) raised high above his head waving enthusiastically, screen-right hand resting down at his side, big joyful crinkly-eyed smile. Lantern on the ground at screen-right boot.
5. 'laugh' (bottom-middle): Laughing heartily with mouth open in a big happy laugh, both hands placed on his belly. Lantern on the ground at screen-right boot.
6. 'pat' (bottom-right): Bending forward slightly at the waist, reaching his screen-left hand down to pat something small at knee height, screen-right hand back. Lantern on ground at screen-right boot.
